title: tau configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/tau/config.json — a JSONC file (// and /* */ comments allowed). Every key is optional; `tau config validate` reports unknown keys.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema. Written by `tau init`; accepted but ignored by the loader.

provider.description: Active provider name — selects the API endpoint and default model. TAU_ENDPOINT overrides the endpoint.

model.description: Model id, or 'provider/id' shorthand. Defaults to the provider's default model.

api_key.description: Global API key — used only when no keys[] entry or provider env var matches. Stored in plaintext; prefer env vars.

keys.description: Per-provider API keys — an entry outranks that provider's env var and the global api_key.

mode.description: Output format for results: 'json' (agent-friendly envelopes) or 'text' (human-readable prose).

thinking.description: Emit reasoning/thinking chunks alongside the response.

debug.description: Write perf stats and tool I/O diagnostics to stderr.

max_tokens.description: Cap on output tokens per response.

context_window.description: Token capacity used for the auto-compaction threshold; defaults to the provider's context window.

auto_compact.description: Auto-compact history when estimated tokens exceed compact_threshold of context_window.

compact_threshold.description: Fraction of context_window that triggers auto-compaction.

compact_keep_recent_tokens.description: Recent tokens kept verbatim through compaction.

goal_max_iterations.description: Per-run agentic loop cap in /goal mode.

goal_max_continues.description: Cross-invocation continuation cap for goal mode.
